chunks.title: Webhook signature verification fails
chunks.text: Your Webhook endpoint receives a request, but signature verification fails.

chunks.title: Webhook signature verification fails
chunks.text: - Your framework parsed or reformatted the JSON before verification. - The verifier uses the wrong Webhook secret. - Middleware altered whitespace, encoding, or field order in the body. - The timestamp is handled as seconds instead of Unix milliseconds. - The signed string uses the wrong concatenation format. - The comparison is not constant-time and fails or leaks timing information.

chunks.title: Webhook signature verification fails
chunks.text: - Copy the current Webhook secret from Developer settings. - Confirm the request headers include X-Kyren-Signature and X-Kyren-Timestamp . - Confirm the timestamp value is a millisecond timestamp, such as 1736932200000 .

chunks.title: Webhook signature verification fails
chunks.text: - Verify against the raw request body bytes before JSON parsing. - Build the signed string as timestamp + "." + raw body . - Compute sha256= plus the HMAC-SHA256 digest using the Webhook secret. - Compare the expected and received signatures with a constant-time function.

chunks.title: Webhook signature verification fails
chunks.text: Change the route to read the raw body for Kyren Webhooks, use the current Webhook secret, treat timestamps as Unix milliseconds, and match the documented signing format exactly.

chunks.title: Webhook signature verification fails
chunks.text: Contact Kyren support with the event time, order number, timestamp header, and a redacted description of your verification code. Do not send the Webhook secret.

chunks.title: Webhook Events
chunks.text: Kyren Pay sends webhook notifications for the following event types.

chunks.title: Webhook Events
chunks.text: Event Description Trigger --- --- --- order.paid A payment has been confirmed Customer completes checkout order.refunded A refund has been applied to an order A refund succeeds The current order integration does not emit an order.closed webhook. Query GET /v1/orders/{orderId} to reconcile unpaid terminal states such as FAILED , CLOSED , or REVOKED ; see Orders.

chunks.title: Webhook Events
chunks.text: All webhook events share the same top-level structure: Field Type Description --- --- --- id string Unique event identifier (use for deduplication) type string The event type created at integer Unix timestamp in milliseconds data object Event-specific payload

chunks.title: Webhook Events
chunks.text: Sent when a customer successfully completes a payment. Field Type Description --- --- --- order id string The order ID product id string The product that was purchased; may be empty for orders without a product customer email string \ null Customer's email address, if available amount string Original/base order amount; excludes an additional fee charged to the payer currency string Three-letter currency code net amount string Amount after fees paid at integer \ null When the payment was confirmed (Unix timestamp in milliseconds), if available metadata object \ null Merchant metadata from the checkout session; internal provider fields are filtered out This is the most important event. Use it to fulfill orders — for example, adding credits to a user's account.

chunks.title: Webhook Events
chunks.text: Sent when a refund has been applied to an order. Use this event to update entitlement, balance, or reconciliation records in your system. See Order refunds for the dashboard refund request flow and refund status definitions. Field Type Description --- --- --- order id string The order ID refund id string The refund ID refund status string Order refund status, such as PARTIAL or FULL amount string Amount refunded by this event currency string Three-letter currency code refunded amount string Total refunded amount on the order after this refund original amount string Original/base order amount; excludes an additional fee charged to the payer reason string \ null Refund reason metadata object \ null Merchant metadata from the checkout session; internal provider fields are filtered out

chunks.title: Webhook Events
chunks.text: If dispute processing is supported and enabled for your account, you may also receive these notifications. Availability depends on the provider and operational configuration; confirm it with Kyren support. See Disputes. Event Trigger --- --- dispute.created A dispute case is first matched to your order and becomes visible to you dispute.updated Merchant-visible case details or financial projection change Both use the same event envelope. Their data contains the following case snapshot; nullable values may be unavailable: Field Type Description --- --- --- id string Dispute case ID, distinct from the top-level event ID provider string Payment provider provider dispute id string \ null Provider's dispute ID order id string \ null Related order ID type , status string Case type and normalized status provider status string \ null Provider status amount , currency string Case amount and currency reason code , reason string \ null Dispute reason defendable boolean \ null Whether defense is available, if known response due at , occurred at integer \ null Unix timestamps in milliseconds updated at integer Case update time in milliseconds financial status , financial allocation status string Case financial processing and allocation status settlement currency string \ null Currency of the financial amounts below allocated merchant principal , allocated rolling reserve string Principal and reserve allocated to this case frozen principal , charged back principal string Principal frozen or charged back for this case offset rolling reserve , chargeback fee string Reserve offset and merchant chargeback fee for this case projection state string \ null State of the related order's financial projection related case count integer Number of cases sharing the order projection shared order projection boolean Whether multiple cases share that projection These are operational case notifications. A change to status alone does not prove a balance movement; use the financial fields and dashboard records for reconciliation. Financial amounts are scoped to the individual case, even when shared order projection is true.

chunks.title: Webhook Events
chunks.text: Here's how to handle webhook events in your endpoint: The handlers must durably complete their work before acknowledging the event. For longer processing, use the durable queue pattern and return 2xx only after persistence succeeds.

chunks.title: Webhook Overview
chunks.text: Webhooks allow Kyren Pay to notify your server when a payment or refund succeeds. See Events for supported events and optional dispute notifications.

chunks.title: Webhook Overview
chunks.text: 1. An event occurs (e.g., a customer completes a payment) 2. Kyren Pay sends an HTTP POST request to your configured webhook URL 3. The request includes a signature for verification 4. Your server verifies the signature, persists the event, and returns 200 within 10 seconds 5. Your worker processes the persisted event with idempotency and its own retries

chunks.title: Webhook Overview
chunks.text: Set up your webhook endpoint in the Merchant Dashboard: 1. Go to Dashboard Developer Webhook Settings 2. Enter your Webhook URL (e.g., https://yoursite.com/webhooks/kyren ) 3. Copy your Webhook Secret — you'll need this to verify signatures Your webhook URL must: - Use HTTPS (required for production) - Be publicly accessible - Complete a 2xx response within 10 seconds, after durable persistence succeeds

chunks.title: Webhook Overview
chunks.text: Every webhook request includes these headers: Header Description --- --- Content-Type application/json X-Kyren-Signature HMAC-SHA256 signature for verification X-Kyren-Timestamp Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the webhook was sent The request body is a JSON object:

chunks.title: Webhook Overview
chunks.text: Always verify the X-Kyren-Signature header to ensure the webhook is authentic. See Webhook Signatures. Verify the signature and durably store the event before returning 200 . Return non- 2xx if persistence fails, so Kyren can retry. Use the event id to deduplicate. Your endpoint may receive the same event more than once due to retries. For asynchronous processing, persist to a durable inbox or queue and acknowledge only after storage succeeds. Workers need their own retries after Kyren receives 2xx .

chunks.title: Webhook Overview
chunks.text: See all event types Verify webhook signatures Understand retry behavior

chunks.title: Webhook Retries
chunks.text: If your webhook endpoint doesn't respond with a 2xx status code, Kyren Pay will automatically retry the delivery.

chunks.title: Webhook Retries
chunks.text: For order and dispute events described in this guide, Kyren Pay makes up to 7 delivery attempts in total: the initial attempt plus 6 retries . Attempt Delay After Failure --- --- 1st retry 1 minute 2nd retry 5 minutes 3rd retry 15 minutes 4th retry 1 hour 5th retry 6 hours 6th retry 24 hours Each delay is measured from the preceding failed attempt; actual dispatch may occur later. After 7 failed delivery attempts, the webhook is marked as failed and automatic retries stop.

chunks.title: Webhook Retries
chunks.text: A webhook delivery is considered failed if: - Your endpoint returns a non- 2xx HTTP status code (e.g., 400 , 500 ) - Your endpoint doesn't complete its response within 10 seconds - The connection to your server fails (DNS error, connection refused, timeout) A 2xx response (e.g., 200 , 201 , 204 ) is considered a successful delivery regardless of the response body.

chunks.title: Webhook Retries
chunks.text: Since webhooks may be retried, your endpoint should be idempotent — processing the same event multiple times should produce the same result.

chunks.title: Webhook Retries
chunks.text: Every webhook event has a unique id field. Store processed event IDs durably, with a unique constraint, and commit the business change and processed marker in the same transaction: The database methods above illustrate the transaction contract; adapt them to your storage system. Also protect the business operation with a stable identifier, such as order id for payment fulfillment or refund id for a refund. For dispute updates, do not deduplicate only by case ID because one case can have multiple updates.

chunks.title: Webhook Retries
chunks.text: For long processing, validate the signature and durably persist the event in an inbox or queue before returning 200 . A worker can then process it with its own retries. If persistence fails, return a non- 2xx response so Kyren can retry:

chunks.title: Webhook Retries
chunks.text: When troubleshooting delivery, compare Kyren Webhook events with your own server logs. Record: - Your configured Webhook URL - The event type and order number - The timestamp when your server received the request - The response code or error your server returned If you need Kyren to check delivery attempts, contact support with those details.

chunks.title: Webhook Retries
chunks.text: Problem Solution --- --- Not receiving webhooks Check your webhook URL is correct and publicly accessible Signature verification fails Ensure you're using the raw request body (not parsed JSON) Frequent timeouts Persist to a durable inbox or queue, return 200 within 10 seconds, then process with worker retries Duplicate events Implement idempotency using the event id field

chunks.title: Webhook Signatures
chunks.text: Every webhook request from Kyren Pay includes a cryptographic signature that you should verify to ensure the request is authentic and hasn't been tampered with.

chunks.title: Webhook Signatures
chunks.text: Kyren Pay uses HMAC-SHA256 to sign webhook payloads: The signature and timestamp are sent in HTTP headers: Header Example --- --- X-Kyren-Signature sha256=5d2dc4f1a... X-Kyren-Timestamp 1704628800000 (Unix timestamp in milliseconds)

chunks.title: Webhook Signatures
chunks.text: Read X-Kyren-Signature and X-Kyren-Timestamp from the request headers. Verify the timestamp is within 5 minutes (300000 milliseconds) of the current time. This prevents replay attacks. Concatenate timestamp + "." + raw request body , then compute HMAC-SHA256 using your webhook secret. Compare the computed signature with the one in the header. Use constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.

chunks.title: Webhook Signatures
chunks.text: Important security considerations: - Always verify signatures before processing events - Use constant-time comparison functions to prevent timing attacks - Reject requests with timestamps older than 5 minutes (300000 ms) to prevent replay attacks - Use the raw request body for signature verification (before JSON parsing)

chunks.title: 簡介
chunks.text: 啟潤支付是專為 中國出海 AI Startup 打造的收款平台。它提供標準化的方式來接收海外客戶的付款，讓你專注於產品開發，而非支付基礎設施。 選擇先使用控制台、串接 API、收第一筆款，或準備上線。 幾分鐘內即可上線。建立產品，產生收銀連結，開始接收付款。 透過單一整合支援信用卡、微信支付、支付寶和 PayNow。 透過 HMAC-SHA256 簽名的 Webhook 接收即時支付通知，實現安全的伺服器間通訊。 簡潔的 REST API、完善的文檔和多語言程式碼範例。

chunks.text: 点击支付方式对应的 设置手续费承担方式 。弹窗显示订单总费率和每笔固定手续费，并支持填写： 设置 含义 --- --- 客户承担费率 用于计算 Checkout 附加费用的客户费率分担。控制台输入百分比； customerFeeRate 使用十进制费率，例如 0.01 表示 1%。 客户承担每笔固定手续费 客户每笔承担的固定部分，以 USD 配置，对应 customerPerTransactionFee 。 商户承担部分 分别按总费率、总固定手续费减去客户承担部分自动计算。 Checkout 展示文案 可选的 Checkout 描述，最多 80 个字符。 客户承担的两项均不能为负，也不能超过对应的订单总手续费。两项均设为零表示手续费全部由商户承担。点击 保存 后，先用新的 Checkout 核对，再交付客户。 原始订单金额是商品价格；应付金额会加上客户承担的手续费，商户净收入则反映商户承担部分及适用保证金。固定手续费始终以 USD 配置，即使订单使用其他币种。对账时查看订单中的应付金额、费用分担、换汇及结算金额。修改配置不会重写已有订单的费用快照。 Checkout 会计入附加费用本身产生的处理费： （原始金额 × 客户费率 + 换算为订单币种的客户固定费）÷（1 − 订单总费率） ，结果四舍五入至两位小数。例如原始金额 USD 100.00、总费率 3%、客户承担 1% 加 USD 0.20，附加费用为 USD 1.24，应付金额为 USD 101.24。实际扣款以 Checkout 报价和订单记录为准。

chunks.title: mapi.php 直连创建支付
chunks.text: /epay/mapi.php 是服务端到服务端的 Epay 兼容端点。它接收表单 POST ，创建或复用 Kyren 订单，并根据所选渠道返回 payurl 、 qrcode 、 img 、 trade no 等 Epay 风格字段。 该端点使用 pid + sign ，不使用 x-api-key 。由于它是服务端直连端点，开启 API IP 白名单时可能会校验来源 IP。白名单校验失败时可能返回数字 code 为 0 ，并附带 msg 。

chunks.title: Epay MD5 签名
chunks.text: Epay 兼容请求使用 pid + sign ，不使用 x-api-key 。 sign 的生成方式是：对 k=v&... 拼接商户密钥后的字符串计算小写 MD5。

chunks.title: Epay MD5 签名
chunks.text: 1. 移除 sign 和 sign type 。 2. 去掉空值参数。 3. 将剩余参数按 key 升序排列，使用 ASCII key 顺序。 4. 将每个参数拼成 k=v ，并用 & 连接。 5. 将商户密钥直接追加到连接后的字符串末尾。 6. 计算 MD5，并输出小写十六进制字符串。 不要额外拼接 &key= 。商户密钥是直接追加到参数字符串末尾。

chunks.text: 启润支付使用标准 HTTP 状态码来表示 API 请求的成功或失败。

chunks.title: 错误处理
chunks.text: 状态码 描述 --- --- 200 成功 — 请求已成功处理 201 已创建 — 资源创建成功 400 错误请求 — 参数无效 401 未认证 — 缺少或无效的 API 密钥 403 禁止访问 — 权限不足 404 未找到 — 资源不存在 409 冲突 — 资源状态或幂等冲突 429 请求过多 — 超出频率限制 500 服务器内部错误 — 我们这边出了问题 503 服务不可用 — 上游服务错误

chunks.text: 内置客户端不发送 money type ，启润因此按 CNY 收款。界面的 USD 或 CNY 显示偏好不会改变请求币种。 USD 显示模式下，请求充值余额 A 的 Epay 基础金额（CNY）为 A × Price × 用户组充值倍率 × 预设优惠折扣 ，格式化为两位小数；入账内部额度为 A × QuotaPerUnit 。首次验证可使用 USD 显示、用户组倍率 1 、折扣 1 。假设你主动设定 Price = 7.00 ，充值 USD 10.00 余额将发送 CNY 70.00 的 Epay 基础金额，入账 USD 10.00 。 7.00 仅为配置示例，不代表当前汇率。 Epay 基础金额不一定等于最终收银总额。启润可能按支付渠道的费用分担设置增加客户承担的费用；只有不增加此类费用时，示例的最终总额才是 CNY 70.00 。Epay 通知和订单查询的 money 返回基础金额，new-api 根据已保存的充值金额计算额度，不会把额外费用计入余额。应分别核对基础金额、收银台总额和预期入账余额。 TOKENS 显示模式会通过 QuotaPerUnit 换算请求；使用前应核对已安装版本的取整和充值预设。向用户开放前，通过小额付款确认实付金额与入账额度。金额计算和请求、额度入账计算。

chunks.title: 简介
chunks.text: 启润支付是专为 中国出海 AI Startup 打造的收款平台。它提供标准化的方式来接收海外客户的付款，让你专注于产品开发，而非支付基础设施。 选择先使用控制台、对接 API、收第一笔款，或准备上线。 几分钟内即可上线。创建产品，生成收银链接，开始接收付款。 通过单一集成支持信用卡、微信支付、支付宝和 PayNow。 通过 HMAC-SHA256 签名的 Webhook 接收实时支付通知，实现安全的服务器间通信。 简洁的 REST API、完善的文档和多语言代码示例。
tokens: 它提供标准化的方式来接收海外客户的付款
通过单一集成支持信用卡
实现安全的服务器间通信
完善的文档和多语言代码示例
